correctness.rationale: Explicit definitions and normalized signs yield W=(per+det)/2. The row-and-column gauge has rank 9 and reduces all 2^25 frequencies exactly 512-to-one to a 16-bit cube. Independent exact Python Walsh and C++ per+det methods both calculate all 65,536 reduced coefficients and verify the identical ten-level histogram, Parseval identity, rank, minimum nonzero 4 and projection absolute sum 4,265,776. All frequencies with <=3 entries were separately checked in 25-dimensional space. The local inclusion-exclusion proof establishes exactly 400 three-edge path cancellations, and translation averaging proves norm-minimality among projections. Finite computations prove only this finite domain.

value.rationale: The 60 even-permutation matrices form the natural incidence codebook for the smallest nonabelian simple alternating group A5. Compared with the 120-permutation case, parity restriction changes the exact Fourier kernel and raises optimal range-projection amplification dramatically (266611/4096 versus 33045/4096). The unique first cancellation geometry (all and only 400 length-three bipartite paths) is structural and independent of brute-force full-table inspection. It provides a complete recoverability and conditioning benchmark for a canonical parity-constrained perfect-matching family, without requiring a general-dimension theorem.
